items.summary: Ensure the Attendance Register is accessible to non-admin staff users: staff must be able to open the “Attendance” tab and view workers and attendance records without authorization traps; only admin-only actions (adding workers, marking attendance) should remain restricted.

Backend authorization fix: update backend authorization logic so that authenticated staff principals have the required “user” permissions to call user-level endpoints used by Attendance (at minimum: getWorkers, getAttendanceRecords, getWorkerAttendance, getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) while still preventing anonymous access and keeping admin-only endpoints restricted.

Frontend resilience: in the Attendance tab, add a clear user-facing error state (English text) when attendance-related queries fail (e.g., due to authorization), instead of silently showing empty data; include guidance to re-login and/or contact an admin if access is missing.
